add-text-field-to-pdf-page.title: Add Text Box Field to PDF Page
add-text-field-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to insert a TextBoxField named CustomerName onto the first page of a PDF at specific rectangle coordinates using Aspose.Pdf.

add-unchecked-checkbox-field-to-pdf.title: Add Unchecked Checkbox Field to PDF Page 2
add-unchecked-checkbox-field-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to insert an unchecked checkbox form field named 'AgreeTerms' on the second page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-radio-button-group-to-pdf-form.title: Add PaymentMethod Radio Button Group to PDF Form
add-radio-button-group-to-pdf-form.description: Demonstrates how to create a radio button field with "Credit" and "PayPal" options on page 3 of an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-submit-button-to-pdf-form.title: Add Submit Form Button to PDF
add-submit-button-to-pdf-form.description: Shows how to create a button field on a PDF page and attach a SubmitFormAction that posts the form data to a specified URL.

add-javascript-alert-to-push-button.title: Attach JavaScript Alert to PDF Push Button
add-javascript-alert-to-push-button.description: Shows how to bind an existing PDF, attach JavaScript that displays an alert to a push button named "ShowInfo", and save the updated PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

decorate-pdf-form-field-appearance.title: Decorate PDF Form Field with Custom Border, Background, and Font
decorate-pdf-form-field-appearance.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormEditor to set a custom border color, background shade, and font style for a specific form field and then save the updated PDF.

set-form-field-alignment-to-center.title: Center Align PDF Form Field Using FormEditor
set-form-field-alignment-to-center.description: Shows how to load a PDF, bind a FormEditor, set the alignment of the "Address" form field to center, and save the updated document.

set-custom-attribute-on-pdf-form-field.title: Set Custom Data Attribute on PDF Form Field
set-custom-attribute-on-pdf-form-field.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF, assign a custom attribute (data-id) to a form field, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

set-numeric-limit-for-pdf-form-field.title: Set Numeric Limit for PDF Form Field
set-numeric-limit-for-pdf-form-field.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF, define a numeric range for a form field named "Quantity", and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-list-item-to-pdf-dropdown.title: Add List Item to PDF Dropdown Field
add-list-item-to-pdf-dropdown.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormEditor to add a new list item to an existing dropdown form field in a PDF document.

remove-list-item-from-pdf-form.title: Remove List Item from PDF Form Field
remove-list-item-from-pdf-form.description: Shows how to open a PDF, retrieve a list field on a specific page, delete a particular option, and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

copy-field-content-between-pdf-form-fiel.title: Copy Text Between PDF Form Fields
copy-field-content-between-pdf-form-fiel.description: Shows how to load a PDF, retrieve two text box form fields, copy the value from the source field to the target field, and save the modified document.

clone-form-field-to-page-5.title: Clone a PDF Form Field to Page 5
clone-form-field-to-page-5.description: Demonstrates how to copy an existing form field definition and place a cloned field on a different page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

move-pdf-form-field.title: Move Form Field to Coordinates on Page 2
move-pdf-form-field.description: Demonstrates how to reposition an existing PDF form field to a specific location, size, and page using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-pdf-form-field.title: Remove Obsolete Form Field from PDF
remove-pdf-form-field.description: Shows how to delete a specific form field from a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf's Form API.

rename-pdf-form-field.title: Rename PDF Form Field Using Aspose.Pdf
rename-pdf-form-field.description: Shows how to rename a form field throughout a PDF document using the Aspose.Pdf Facades FormEditor class.

add-email-validation-javascript-to-pdf-f.title: Add Email Validation JavaScript to PDF Form Field
add-email-validation-javascript-to-pdf-f.description: Demonstrates how to attach a JavaScript action to a PDF form TextBox field to validate an email address on the blur (OnLostFocus) event using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-fdf.title: Export PDF Form Fields to FDF
export-pdf-form-fields-to-fdf.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF document with PdfFormEditor and export all its form fields to an FDF file for external processing.

import-xfdf-data-into-pdf-form.title: Import XFDF Form Data into an Existing PDF
import-xfdf-data-into-pdf-form.description: Demonstrates how to bind an existing PDF, import form field values from an XFDF file, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

decorate-checkbox-fields-in-pdfs.title: Apply Consistent Decoration to Checkbox Fields in Multiple PDFs
decorate-checkbox-fields-in-pdfs.description: Shows how to batch‑process PDFs in a folder, configure border and background colors for all checkbox form fields using Aspose.Pdf's FormEditor, and save the updated documents.

batch-update-submit-button-urls.title: Batch Update Submit Button URLs in PDFs
batch-update-submit-button-urls.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through a folder of PDF files and change the submit button action URL for each form field using Aspose.Pdf facades.

clear-and-populate-list-box-field.title: Clear and Populate Dropdown List in PDF Form
clear-and-populate-list-box-field.description: Demonstrates how to remove all existing items from a PDF combo box field and add new options using Aspose.Pdf.

populate-country-list-box-pdf.title: Add a Country List Box to a PDF Form
populate-country-list-box-pdf.description: Shows how to create a PDF document, add a list‑box form field, and populate it with 195 country names using Aspose.Pdf.Facades PdfFormEditor.

set-form-field-readonly-currency-appeara.title: Set Form Field to Read‑Only and Display as Currency
set-form-field-readonly-currency-appeara.description: Shows how to locate a TextBoxField in a PDF, make it read‑only, and assign a currency‑formatted value using Aspose.Pdf.

attach-javascript-clear-discountcode-fie.title: Attach Focus-Clear JavaScript to DiscountCode Field
attach-javascript-clear-discountcode-fie.description: Loads a PDF, finds the 'DiscountCode' text box form field, attaches a JavaScript action that clears the field on focus, and saves the updated document.

copy-form-fields-from-template-to-pdf.title: Copy Form Fields from Template PDF to Another PDF
copy-form-fields-from-template-to-pdf.description: Shows how to copy form field definitions from a template PDF to a target PDF by cloning each field and adding it to the target document using Aspose.Pdf.

move-pdf-form-fields-by-offset.title: Move PDF Form Fields by Offset
move-pdf-form-fields-by-offset.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating over all form fields, shifting each field's rectangle by a specified (X,Y) offset, and saving the updated document.

batch-rename-pdf-form-fields.title: Batch Rename PDF Form Fields from Old_ to New_
batch-rename-pdf-form-fields.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, iterate over its form fields, and rename all fields that start with the prefix "Old_" to a new "New_" prefix using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

set-text-field-to-multiline.title: Set Multiline Property for PDF Text Field
set-text-field-to-multiline.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate the 'Comments' text box field, enable multiline input, and save the updated document.

set-signature-field-border-width.title: Set Custom Border Thickness for PDF Form Field
set-signature-field-border-width.description: Demonstrates how to apply a 2‑point border thickness to a PDF form field named "Signature" using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFormEditor facade.

set-form-field-background-color.title: Set Form Field Background Color Using SetFieldAppearance
set-form-field-background-color.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, use FormEditor to change the appearance of a form field named "Status", and save the updated document.

attach-js-validation-to-pdf-submit-butto.title: Attach Validation JavaScript to PDF Submit Button
attach-js-validation-to-pdf-submit-butto.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating JavaScript that validates required fields, and attaching it to a submit button using Aspose.Pdf's FormEditor.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json.title: Export PDF Form Field Definitions to JSON
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json.description: Loads a PDF document, iterates through its form fields, extracts key properties (name, type, value, read‑only, required, tooltip) and writes the definitions to a formatted JSON file for external integration.

create-pdf-form-fields-from-json.title: Import JSON Form Field Definitions into PDF
create-pdf-form-fields-from-json.description: Reads a JSON file that describes form fields and creates matching PDF form fields (text box, checkbox, radio button, list box) in a new document using Aspose.Pdf.

set-phone-number-field-limit.title: Set Maximum Length for PDF Form Field
set-phone-number-field-limit.description: Shows how to bind a PDF, set a character limit on a specific form field using PdfFormEditor, and save the updated document.

set-date-field-format.title: Set Date Field Format in PDF Form
set-date-field-format.description: Demonstrates how to change the display format of a PDF form's Date field to MM/dd/yyyy using Aspose.Pdf and optionally set its value.

add-reset-form-button-to-pdf.title: Add Reset Form Button to PDF
add-reset-form-button-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a push button into an existing PDF that clears all form fields when clicked, using Aspose.Pdf and JavaScript.

restrict-pdf-form-field-to-integer-0-100.title: Add Integer Range Validation to PDF Form Field
restrict-pdf-form-field-to-integer-0-100.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, locate a text box form field named "Score", and attach JavaScript validation that restricts input to integer values between 0 and 100.

attach-javascript-validation-to-pdf-form.title: Attach JavaScript Validation to PDF Form Field
attach-javascript-validation-to-pdf-form.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate the "Age" text box form field, attach a JavaScript OnValidate action that alerts when the value is under 18, and save the modified document.

copy-image-field-to-another-field.title: Copy Image Field to Another PDF Form Field
copy-image-field-to-another-field.description: Demonstrates how to retrieve an image from a PDF form field and set it into another field using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFormEditor, then save the updated document.

remove-empty-pdf-form-field.title: Remove Empty Form Field from PDF
remove-empty-pdf-form-field.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locating a specific form field, checking if it contains user input, and deleting the field only when it is empty before saving the document.

rename-pdf-form-fields-csv-mapping.title: Rename PDF Form Fields Using a CSV Mapping
rename-pdf-form-fields-csv-mapping.description: Demonstrates how to read a CSV file containing old‑new field name pairs and use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.FormEditor to rename form fields in a PDF and save the updated document.

add-digital-signature-field-and-sign-pdf.title: Add Digital Signature Field and Sign PDF
add-digital-signature-field-and-sign-pdf.description: Shows how to create a visible signature field, load a PKCS#1 certificate, and apply a digital signature to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

mark-pdf-form-field-required.title: Set PDF Form Field as Required with Asterisk Indicator
mark-pdf-form-field-required.description: Demonstrates how to mark a PDF form field as required and enable the asterisk visual cue using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileFormEditor.

apply-custom-font-to-pdf-form-text-field.title: Apply Arial Bold Font to PDF Text Fields
apply-custom-font-to-pdf-form-text-field.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through all form fields, and sets the default appearance of each text box to use the Arial Bold font. The updated document is then saved.

batch-add-selectall-checkbox-to-pdf.title: Batch Add SelectAll Checkbox to PDFs
batch-add-selectall-checkbox-to-pdf.description: Shows how to iterate through a folder of PDF files, add a checkbox form field named "SelectAll" to the first page of each document, and save the updated PDFs.

move-footernote-to-bottom-margin.title: Move Form Field to Bottom Margin on All PDF Pages
move-footernote-to-bottom-margin.description: Demonstrates how to reposition a specific form field to the bottom margin of each page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's FormEditor and page size calculations.

set-field-appearance-format-price.title: Set Form Field Appearance with Two Decimal Places
set-field-appearance-format-price.description: Demonstrates binding a PDF, applying a format string to the "Price" text box field to force two decimal places, and saving the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

attach-javascript-to-pdf-form-field.title: Attach JavaScript Calculation to PDF Form Field
attach-javascript-to-pdf-form-field.description: Shows how to add a JavaScript calculate action to a PDF form field using Aspose.Pdf so that the TotalPrice field updates automatically when the Quantity field changes.

export-import-pdf-form-xml.title: Export PDF Form Fields to XML
export-import-pdf-form-xml.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF document using PdfFormEditor and export all its form fields to an XML file for archival and later re‑import.

import-pdf-form-fields-from-xml-preserve.title: Import PDF Form Fields from XML While Preserving Order
import-pdf-form-fields-from-xml-preserve.description: Shows how to load a PDF, import form data from an XML file using the Form facade, and save the updated PDF while keeping the original field order.

add-list-box-field-to-pdf-form.title: Add Drop‑Down List Field to PDF
add-list-box-field-to-pdf-form.description: Demonstrates how to add a combo box (drop‑down list) form field to an existing PDF, populate it with options, and set a default selection using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-button-fields-from-pdf-form.title: Remove Button Fields from PDF Form
remove-button-fields-from-pdf-form.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, identify all button (push‑button) form fields, delete them, and save the simplified document using Aspose.PDF for .NET.

merge-pdf-forms-unique-field-names.title: Rename Duplicate PDF Form Fields in Batch
merge-pdf-forms-unique-field-names.description: Processes all PDFs in a folder and renames duplicate form field names by appending an incremental index, using the Aspose.Pdf Facade to perform the rename operation.

add-email-validation-to-pdf-form-field.title: Apply Email Regex Validation to PDF Form Field
add-email-validation-to-pdf-form-field.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF, set a regular‑expression validation rule for the "Email" form field, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

decorate-pdf-form-field-with-header-imag.title: Decorate PDF Header Field with Background Image and Centered Text
decorate-pdf-form-field-with-header-imag.description: Demonstrates locating a form field, adding a background image behind it, centering the field's text alignment, and filling the field using Aspose.Pdf facades.

add-hidden-version-field-to-pdf.title: Add Hidden Numeric Version Field to PDF
add-hidden-version-field-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a hidden numeric textbox field named "Version" with a value of 2 into an existing PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

copy-rename-pdf-form-field.title: Copy Form Field to New Page in PDF
copy-rename-pdf-form-field.description: Shows how to duplicate an existing form field (AddressBlock) and create a new field (BillingAddress) on page 3 of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

move-signature-field-to-lower-right-corn.title: Move Signature Field to Lower Right Corner on Page 5
move-signature-field-to-lower-right-corn.description: Shows how to locate a signature form field in a PDF, compute a rectangle for the lower‑right corner of page 5, and reposition the field using Aspose.Pdf.

set-rich-text-appearance-for-pdf-form-fi.title: Enable Rich Text Formatting for a PDF Form Field
set-rich-text-appearance-for-pdf-form-fi.description: Demonstrates how to enable rich‑text support on a PDF form field by configuring its appearance and setting the rich‑text flag using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFormEditor.

add-form-load-javascript-to-pdf.title: Attach JavaScript to PDF Form Load Event to Populate Date Field
add-form-load-javascript-to-pdf.description: Shows how to bind a PDF, add a document‑level JavaScript that sets the "Date" field to the current date when the document opens, and save the updated PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

export-checkbox-fields-to-fdf.title: Export Checkbox Field Definitions to FDF
export-checkbox-fields-to-fdf.description: Shows how to extract only checkbox fields from a PDF form and write their definitions to an FDF file using Aspose.Pdf.

import-checkboxes-from-fdf.title: Import Checkbox Definitions from FDF into PDF
import-checkboxes-from-fdf.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, bind it to the Form facade, import checkbox definitions from an FDF file, and save the merged PDF without duplicating fields.

add-state-combobox-to-pdf.title: Add State Combo Box to PDF
add-state-combobox-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a PDF, add a combo box form field named "State", and fill it with US state abbreviations using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-non-whitelisted-items-from-pdf-co.title: Filter PDF List Box Items Using a Whitelist
remove-non-whitelisted-items-from-pdf-co.description: Demonstrates binding a PDF, reading the items of a list box field, removing entries that are not in a predefined whitelist, updating the field, and saving the modified document.

make-taxrate-readonly-add-js.title: Set TaxRate Field Read‑Only and Calculate Value with JavaScript
make-taxrate-readonly-add-js.description: Loads a PDF, makes the "TaxRate" form field read‑only, attaches JavaScript that computes tax from the "Subtotal" field, and saves the modified document.

decorate-list-fields-uniform-border.title: Uniformly Style List Box Form Fields in a PDF
decorate-list-fields-uniform-border.description: Loads a PDF, finds all ListBox form fields, applies a consistent border width and background color, and saves the updated document.

rename-pdf-form-fields-to-camelcase.title: Rename PDF Form Fields to camelCase
rename-pdf-form-fields-to-camelcase.description: Shows how to load a PDF, retrieve all form field names, convert each name to camelCase, rename the fields using PdfFormEditor, and save the updated document.

add-print-button-to-pdf.title: Add Print Button to PDF Using Aspose.Pdf
add-print-button-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a push button named PrintForm into a PDF that triggers the print dialog via JavaScript using Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-form-field-hidden-exportable.title: Hide PDF Form Field While Keeping It Exportable
set-pdf-form-field-hidden-exportable.description: Demonstrates how to hide a PDF form field using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFormEditor while still allowing its value to be exported in form data submissions.

copy-notes-to-summary.title: Copy Notes Field to Summary in PDF Form
copy-notes-to-summary.description: Demonstrates how to load a filled PDF, read the value of a "Notes" text box field, copy that value to a "Summary" text box field, and save the updated document.

move-pdf-form-fields-page-2.title: Shift PDF Form Fields on Page 2 by 5 Points
move-pdf-form-fields-page-2.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating its form fields, moving the fields on the second page 5 points to the right, and saving the updated document.

set-numeric-validation-two-decimal-disco.title: Add Numeric Validation to PDF Form Field
set-numeric-validation-two-decimal-disco.description: Demonstrates attaching a JavaScript action to a PDF text box field to allow only numeric input with up to two decimal places using Aspose.Pdf.

add-confirmation-dialog-to-pdf-submit-bu.title: Attach Confirmation JavaScript to SubmitForm Button
add-confirmation-dialog-to-pdf-submit-bu.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF, attach a JavaScript confirmation dialog to a SubmitForm button, and save the modified PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-gender-radio-button-group.title: Add Gender Radio Button Group to PDF Form
add-gender-radio-button-group.description: Shows how to insert a radio‑button group named "Gender" with options Male, Female, and Other, and set a default selection in an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

remove-temporary-form-fields-from-pdf.title: Remove Temporary Form Fields from PDF
remove-temporary-form-fields-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, enumerate its form fields, delete those whose names start with "Temp_", and save the cleaned document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

convert-single-line-to-multiline-word-wr.title: Enable Auto‑Wrap and Resize Address TextBox in PDF
convert-single-line-to-multiline-word-wr.description: Loads a PDF, finds the 'Address' text box form field, enables multiline (auto‑wrap) and increases its height, then saves the updated document.

add-hidden-authtoken-field-to-pdf.title: Add Hidden AuthToken Field to PDF
add-hidden-authtoken-field-to-pdf.description: Generates a cryptographically secure token and inserts it as a hidden text box form field named AuthToken into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

duplicate-pdf-form-field.title: Duplicate PDF Form Field Using PdfFormEditor
duplicate-pdf-form-field.description: Shows how to copy an existing form field definition (e.g., "Signature") to a new field name ("SignatureCopy") in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFormEditor facade.

move-pdf-form-field-to-top-left.title: Move PDF Form Field to Top‑Left Corner
move-pdf-form-field-to-top-left.description: Demonstrates how to locate a form field named "Logo" in a PDF, calculate coordinates for the top‑left corner of the first page, and set a specific width and height for the field using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-phone-number-input-mask.title: Set Input Mask on PDF TextBox Field via Reflection
apply-phone-number-input-mask.description: Demonstrates how to apply an input mask "(###) ###‑####" to a PDF form TextBoxField using Aspose.Pdf and reflection to invoke the internal SetOption method.

attach-js-resetform-clear-hidden-fields.title: Attach Reset Form JavaScript to Clear Hidden Fields
attach-js-resetform-clear-hidden-fields.description: Loads a PDF, locates the 'ResetForm' button, and attaches JavaScript that resets the form and clears hidden fields. The same script is also set as a document‑level open action.

export-pdf-form-field-layout-to-json.title: Export PDF Form Field Layout to JSON
export-pdf-form-field-layout-to-json.description: Loads a PDF, extracts each form field's name, type, page number and rectangle coordinates, and writes this layout information to a JSON file for UI reconstruction.

import-pdf-form-layout-from-json.title: Import JSON Field Layout and Add Form Fields to PDF
import-pdf-form-layout-from-json.description: Shows how to read a JSON layout describing form field types and positions, create a PDF with the needed pages, and add the corresponding Aspose.Pdf form fields at the specified coordinates.

batch-add-hidden-guid-field-to-pdfs.title: Batch Add Hidden GUID Field to PDFs
batch-add-hidden-guid-field-to-pdfs.description: Iterates through all PDF files in the "InputForms" folder, adds a hidden text field named "ProcessedDate" containing a newly generated GUID, and overwrites each PDF with the updated document.

add-hidden-sessionid-field-to-pdfs-batch.title: Add Hidden SessionId Field to PDFs in Batch
add-hidden-sessionid-field-to-pdfs-batch.description: Shows how to loop through PDF files, generate a GUID, create a hidden TextBoxField, add it to the document's form, and save the updated PDFs using Aspose.Pdf.

decorate-pdf-form-field-italic-gray.title: Decorate PDF Form Field with Italic Font and Gray Background
decorate-pdf-form-field-italic-gray.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades to set an italic font and a light‑gray background for a specific PDF form field and then applying the appearance.
